UNLOCKING / UNLOCKED
• Solenoid energizes
• Bolt retracts
• Failure counter reset (0)

REJECT / SECURED
• Bolt remains locked
• Failure counter += 1

LOCKOUT ESCALATION
• If failures >= N (5)
• Exponential backoff doubling
• Persisted across reboots

Gate 1 == PASS
AND
Gate 2 s(x) >= tau?
